user.title: SzenzorKozpont
user.description: Target cloud + connection setup. SzenzorKozpont is the native cloud (full features: config, OTA, quota); ThingsBoard mirrors telemetry only. One credential field (API key / token) is used for the selected cloud — for ThingsBoard the DEVICE access token (Devices → Credentials), not the user API key.

data.api_key: API key / token (for the selected cloud)

error.invalid_url: Only https:// URLs are accepted (http:// is allowed on ThingsBoard networks).
error.tb_user_key: This looks like a ThingsBoard USER API key (tb_…); a device access token is required instead (ThingsBoard → Devices → device → Credentials).
